Choose a value from the board. You get 12 seconds to buzz in. After buzzing, type just the answer. Correct answers add the clue value to your score. Wrong answers subtract it. One clue is a hidden Daily Double with a wager.

The checker ignores punctuation, capitalization, articles like “the,” small spelling mistakes, and can accept a last name for many full-name answers.
